adjudication.rationale: The diff does change `TopicEmbed.import` to use `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` and pass `category: eh.try(:category_id)` instead of the global `SiteSetting.embed_category`. However, the claim that “feed-polled or otherwise imported items whose URL host is not exactly an EmbeddableHost row now land in Uncategorized” isn’t supported by what’s shown: host validation for embedding/retrieval was also changed to `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(@embed_url)` in `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`, so URLs whose host doesn’t match a row would be rejected rather than imported. The note that `record_for_host` returns `false` (not `nil`) is true (it does `return false unless ...`), and `try` will return `nil` in that case, but that’s more a design smell than a demonstrated defect/regression in this diff.
